cases.explanation: All four invoice lines match PO-2025-4101 pricing exactly ($18.40/$149.00/$6.95/$42.50) and billed quantities equal the GRN-88301 received quantities (3/7/15/16); subtotal $1,882.45, tax $136.48 (7.25% of subtotal), and total $2,018.93 are all arithmetically correct within tolerance. The bank details (routing 021000021, account 4402198837) match the vendor master and no duplicate invoice number appears in payment history.

Both lines match PO-2025-4102 exactly (30 x $4.15 = $124.50 and 39 x $31.25 = $1,218.75), and quantities match the GRN-88302 receipts (30 and 39). Tax of $94.03 is within $0.02 of the expected 7% x $1,343.25 = $94.0275, total $1,437.28 = subtotal + tax, and no duplicate invoice number or vendor+PO+amount combination exists in payment history. Bank details (Coastal Georgia Bank, routing 061000104, account 7719045512) match the vendor master, so the invoice is approved.

All checks pass: line prices ($62.75, $27.60) and billed quantities (19, 11) exactly match PO-2025-4103 and the received quantities on GRN-88303; line amounts ($1,192.25, $303.60), subtotal ($1,495.85), and total ($1,585.60) all compute correctly, and tax of $89.75 equals 6% x $1,495.85 ($89.751) within the $0.02 tolerance. Bank details (Keystone National, routing 031000503, account 5583920164) match the V03 vendor master, currency USD matches the PO, and no matching vendor/PO/amount or invoice number exists in payment history.

Both lines match PO-2025-4104 exactly in price and quantity: 24 x $87.40 = $2,097.60 and 24 x $612.00 = $14,688.00, with billed quantities equal to the 24/24 received on GRN-88304. Subtotal $16,785.60 is correct, tax at 9.5% computes to $1,594.632 vs. the invoiced $1,594.63 (within the $0.02 tolerance), and the total $18,380.23 equals subtotal + tax. Remit-to details (Puget Sound Trust, routing 125000024, account 9027481133) match the vendor master, and no duplicate invoice number or vendor/PO/amount combination exists in payment history.

All three lines match PO-2025-4105 prices and full GRN-88305 receipts (HE-CB-20: 37 @ $9.85 = $364.45; HE-REL-24: 20 @ $14.20 = $284.00; HE-PSU-24: 25 @ $96.30 = $2,407.50). Subtotal $3,055.95 equals the sum of line amounts, tax $262.81 is within $0.02 of the 8.6% rate ($3,055.95 × 0.086 = $262.81), and total $3,318.76 equals subtotal + tax. Invoice number is not in payment history, no V05/PO-2025-4105 payments exist, currency (USD) matches the PO, and remit-to bank details (Desert West Bank, routing 122100024, account 3348812706) match vendor master V05.

All four lines match PO-2025-4106 exactly on unit price (63.75, 18.50, 425.00, 45.00) and billed quantities (8, 26, 19, 31) equal the quantities fully received on GRN-88306. Line amounts verify (e.g., 19 x 425.00 = 8,075.00), subtotal $10,461.00, tax $0.00 at 0% matching V06's tax rate, and total $10,461.00 are all consistent; currency (USD), remit-to bank details (River City Bank, routing 084000026, account 6650371928) match the vendor master, and no duplicate exists in payment history (ALS-INV-107 is a different invoice/PO/amount).

All three lines match PO-2025-4107 exactly (6 x $74.25 = $445.50, 40 x $189.00 = $7,560.00, 12 x $415.00 = $4,980.00) and match GRN-88307 received quantities (6/40/12). Subtotal $12,985.50, tax $1,051.83 within $0.02 of 8.1% x $12,985.50 = $1,051.83, and total $14,037.33 is correct; no duplicate in payment history and remit-to bank (Front Range Credit Union, routing 107000233, account 8812204575) matches vendor master V07.

All three lines match PO-2025-4108 exactly (22 × $38.90, 5 × $84.50, 16 × $196.00) and equal the received quantities on GRN-88308 (22/5/16). Math is correct: subtotal $4,414.30 equals the sum of line amounts, tax $264.86 is within $0.02 of 6% × $4,414.30 ($264.858), and total $4,679.16 equals subtotal + tax. Bank details (Sawtooth Community Bank, routing 123103729, account 2290156841) match the V08 vendor master record, and no duplicate invoice number, vendor/PO/amount combination, or currency discrepancy exists.

All three lines match PO-2025-4109 exactly (15 @ EUR 21.40, 33 @ EUR 9.60, 27 @ EUR 340.00), and billed quantities equal the GRN-88309 received quantities (15/33/27). Tax of EUR 1,865.38 equals 19% x EUR 9,817.80 subtotal within tolerance, total EUR 11,683.18 = subtotal + tax, currency EUR matches the PO, bank details (Hansa Handelsbank, DE44 5001 0517 / 5407 3249 31) match vendor master V09, and no duplicate invoice number or vendor+PO+amount exists in payment history.

Invoice AMT-101 matches PO-2025-4110 exactly: line AM-VIS-6 billed 37 at $289.00 (received 37) and AM-CHK-125 billed 36 at $412.60 (received 36 per GRN-88310), with line amounts $10,693.00 and $14,853.60 verifying to subtotal $25,546.60 and total $25,546.60 including $0.00 tax at V10's 0% rate. Currency (USD), vendor identity, and remit-to bank details (Pennine & Yorkshire Bank, routing GB29 NWBK 6016, account 1331 9268 19) all match vendor master, and no duplicate invoice number or same vendor/PO/amount payment exists in history.

All three lines match PO-2025-4111 exactly on price (NG-1180 $149.00, NG-4410 $18.40, NG-3305 $42.50), and billed quantities (34/33/7) equal the summed GRN receipts (GRN-88311 + GRN-88312: 17+17=34, 16+17=33, 3+4=7). Tax of $432.88 is within tolerance of the computed $432.88 (5,970.70 x 0.0725 = $432.8758), subtotal $5,970.70 and total $6,403.58 are internally consistent, and the remit-to bank (First Commerce Bank, routing 021000021, account 4402198837) matches vendor master V01 with no duplicate found in payment history.

All four lines match PO-2025-4112 prices and billed quantities equal GRN-88313 received quantities (26/26/40/31); line amounts are correct (e.g., 26 x $118.00 = $3,068.00) and the subtotal of $7,594.55 is the sum of the lines. Tax of $653.14 is within $0.02 of the vendor master rate (0.086 x $7,594.55 = $653.13), total $8,247.69 equals subtotal plus tax, currency USD matches the PO, remit-to bank details (Desert West Bank, routing 122100024, account 3348812706) match vendor master V05, and no duplicate invoice number, PO, or amount appears in payment history.

Line 1 (MF-M8-50) is billed at $49.28/unit vs the PO price of $44.00, a 12.0% difference that exceeds the 0.5% tolerance, so PRICE_MISMATCH applies. All other checks pass: billed quantities match GRN-88314 receipts (9/20/29/12), line amounts, subtotal ($2,302.92), tax ($138.18 = 6% of subtotal), total ($2,441.10), currency (USD), bank details (Keystone National, 031000503/5583920164), and no duplicate in payment history.

Line SO-CHR-T2 is billed at $204.12/unit vs the PO price of $189.00, an 8.0% overcharge that exceeds the 0.5% tolerance ($15.12 difference on 21 units = $317.52). All other checks pass: quantities (21 and 34) match GRN-88315 receipts, line amounts, subtotal ($6,811.02), tax ($551.69 = 8.1% of subtotal), and total ($7,362.71) are arithmetically correct, currency is USD, no duplicate exists in payment history, and remit-to details (Front Range Credit Union, routing 107000233, account 8812204575) match the vendor master.

Line AM-END-12 is billed at $78.43/unit versus the PO price of $68.20/unit, a 15.0% difference that far exceeds the 0.5% tolerance. All other checks pass: billed quantities (22 and 33) match GRN-88316 receipts exactly, line amounts (22×$78.43=$1,725.46; 33×$412.60=$13,615.80), subtotal $15,341.26, tax $0.00 (0% rate), and total $15,341.26 are internally consistent, and the remit-to bank details match vendor master V10.

All three lines are billed in excess of received quantities per GRN-88317: BP-115 billed 38 vs 22 received, BP-201 billed 7 vs 4 received, and BP-330 billed 7 vs 4 received. Prices match the PO ($12.80/$31.25/$58.90), tax of $78.22 equals 7% x $1,117.45 (within tolerance), total $1,195.67 is arithmetically correct, no duplicate exists in payment history, and the remit-to bank details (061000104/7719045512) match vendor master V02, so the invoice is held pending receipt of the remaining goods.

All four billed quantities exceed the total received on GRN-88318 for PO-2025-4117: HE-REL-24 18 vs 10, HE-CB-20 35 vs 21, HE-PSU-24 40 vs 24, and HE-CAB-14 29 vs 17. Prices match the PO exactly, tax of $677.19 equals 8.6% x $7,874.35 subtotal within tolerance, totals are arithmetically correct, bank details (Desert West Bank, 122100024/3348812706) match vendor master V05, and no duplicate invoice number or vendor+PO+amount pair exists in payment history.

All three lines are billed in excess of received quantities per GRN-88319: GP-EAR-200 billed 30 vs 18 received, GP-BOOT-10 billed 35 vs 21 received, and GP-VIS-XL billed 30 vs 18 received. Prices match the PO, line amounts (30x$38.90=$1,167.00; 35x$112.00=$3,920.00; 30x$84.50=$2,535.00), subtotal ($7,622.00), tax (6% x $7,622.00 = $457.32), and total ($8,079.32) are all correct, and bank details match vendor master V08, so only the quantity mismatch applies, requiring a hold.

PO-2025-4119 exists for V04 (Cascadia Chemical Works) in USD, and all line prices ($612.00, $744.50, $87.40), line amounts, subtotal ($6,128.00), tax (9.5% = $582.16), total ($6,710.16), and bank details (routing 125000024 / account 9027481133) match the PO and vendor master. However, no goods receipt note exists for PO-2025-4119 in the GRN records, so receipt cannot be verified. No duplicate was found in payment history.

Invoice bills 33 liftgate services and 15 pallet handling charges, but GRN-88321 (the only GRN for PO-2025-4120) shows only 23 and 8 received respectively, so billed quantities exceed received quantities. All unit prices match the PO ($425.00/$45.00/$18.50), line math and totals are correct ($9,837.50 subtotal, $0.00 tax = 0% x subtotal), currency is USD as on the PO, no duplicate exists in payment history, and bank details (River City Bank, routing 084000026, account 6650371928) match vendor master V06.

Payment history shows invoice INV-25-107 (a formatting variant of INV-2025-0107) already paid to vendor V02 on 2025-06-14 against PO-2025-4121 for the identical total of $2,517.76, satisfying the DUPLICATE condition on both vendor+PO+amount and invoice number. All other checks pass: line amounts ($33.20, $906.25, $1,413.60) match PO prices and GRN-88320 received quantities (8/29/24), tax of $164.71 equals 7% of the $2,353.05 subtotal, and bank details match vendor master.

Invoice ALS-INV-107 from vendor V06 referencing PO-2025-4122 for a total of $13,741.75 already appears in payment history (paid 2025-07-02), making it a duplicate per policy. All other checks pass: line amounts match qty x unit price exactly (e.g., 27 x $425.00 = $11,475.00), subtotal $13,741.75, tax $0.00 at 0% per vendor master, quantities match GRN-88321 receipts (27/23/8/17), prices match the PO, currency is USD, and bank details (routing 084000026, account 6650371928) match the vendor master.

The stated tax of $388.27 does not equal 7.25% × $4,843.15 subtotal, which is $351.13 — a $37.14 difference far exceeding the $0.02 tolerance (TAX_ERROR). All other checks pass: line prices match PO-2025-4123, billed quantities (17/6/30) equal GRN-88322 receipts, line amounts, subtotal, and total are internally consistent, and the remit-to bank (routing 021000021 / account 4402198837) matches vendor master V01 with no duplicate found.

All three lines match PO-2025-4124 on SKU, qty, and unit price (12x21.40, 28x9.60, 33x340.00), quantities match GRN-88323 receipts, the subtotal of EUR 11,745.60 is correct, and bank details match vendor master V09. However, tax at 19% should be EUR 2,231.66 (0.19 x 11,745.60), but the invoice charges EUR 2,284.26 — an overcharge of EUR 52.60, far exceeding the $0.02 tolerance. Since DUPLICATE does not apply (no V09 invoice number or vendor+PO+amount match in payment history), the invoice is placed on hold for the tax discrepancy.

All lines match PO-2025-4125 exactly (SO-FIL-3D: 26 x $156.80 = $4,076.80; SO-CHR-T2: 18 x $189.00 = $3,492.00) and quantities match GRN-88324 receipts (26 and 18). Tax of $613.07 is within $0.02 of the expected 8.1% x $7,568.80 = $613.0728, the total $8,181.87 equals subtotal + tax, currency is USD, bank details match vendor master (routing 107000233 / account 8812204575), and no duplicate was found in payment history (HIST-7102 for V07 is a different PO, amount, and invoice number).

Line 4 (MF-M8-NUT) is billed at 36 × $27.60 = $993.60 but shows $1,021.60, a $28.00 overstatement far beyond the $0.02 tolerance, and the stated subtotal of $2,779.55 exceeds the correct line sum of $2,751.55 by the same $28.00. All other checks pass: unit prices match the PO, billed quantities (15/5/39/36) match GRN-88325 receipts, tax ($166.77 ≈ 6% of $2,779.55) and total ($2,946.32 = subtotal + tax) are internally consistent, and the bank details match vendor master V03.

Invoice remit-to account 7791024468 differs from the vendor master account 3348812706 for V05 (routing 122100024 matches, bank name 'Meridian Trust Bank' differs from 'Desert West Bank'), triggering BANK_CHANGE. All other checks pass: prices match PO ($96.30, $118.00), billed qty equals GRN-88326 receipts (35, 12), subtotal $4,786.50 = lines, tax $411.64 = 8.6% x $4,786.50, total $5,198.14, currency USD matches, and no duplicate in payment history.

The remit-to account 4456108823 differs from the vendor master account 2290156841 for V08 (routing 123103729 matches), triggering BANK_CHANGE. All other checks pass: billed quantities 6 and 17 match GRN-88327, prices $196.00 and $112.00 match the PO, line amounts sum to $3,080.00, tax $184.80 equals 6% of subtotal within $0.02, and total $3,264.80 is correct; no duplicate found in payment history.

The invoice is billed in USD (total $15,588.29) while PO-2025-4129 is denominated in EUR, triggering CURRENCY_MISMATCH. All other checks pass: prices match the PO ($21.40/$9.60/$340.00), billed quantities (39/38/35) equal GRN-88328 receipts, tax of $2,488.89 equals 19% x $13,099.40 within tolerance, and the Hansa Handelsbank routing/account matches vendor master V09.

The invoice references PO-2025-9911, which does not exist in the PO system, and no GRN exists for it, triggering PO_NOT_FOUND and GRN_MISSING. The line items exactly mirror PO-2025-4130 (e.g., 10x AM-CHK-125 @ $412.60, 31x AM-VIS-6 @ $289.00) with a correct subtotal of $16,602.80, $0.00 tax (V10 rate 0%), and bank details matching vendor master, so the likely cause is an incorrect PO reference requiring resolution before approval.

Line 1 (NG-4410) is billed at $20.24 vs the PO unit price of $18.40, a ~10% difference that exceeds the 0.5% tolerance, triggering PRICE_MISMATCH. Every line's billed quantity exceeds total received on GRN-88330 (billed/received: 10/5, 24/12, 6/3, 17/8), triggering QTY_MISMATCH. Tax ($162.00 vs 7.25% x $2,234.55 = $162.0049), totals, bank details, and currency all match within tolerance.

Tax is overstated: at the V04 rate of 9.5%, tax on the $34,277.90 subtotal should be $3,256.40, but the invoice charges $3,300.50 (a $44.10 difference, beyond the $0.02 tolerance); line amounts, subtotal, total, unit prices, billed quantities vs GRN-88331 receipts, and currency all match. Additionally, the remit-to account 6120087745 (Meridian Trust Bank) differs from the vendor master account 9027481133 (Puget Sound Trust) even though the routing number 125000024 matches, triggering BANK_CHANGE.
